messages:
Maria (Partnerships): FYI ACME Marketplace asks us to pin the NVIDIA driver in their image to 530.41 due to certification. They reported a performance regression on CUDA 12.2 in their CI. Can runtime/infra confirm any red flags? @Kai (Eng Runtime) @AJ (Eng Infra) :eyes:

Kai (Eng Runtime): Thanks — tagging in. We have a queued fix for a kernel-launch anomaly on the 530.x line (runtime PR #428), but we validated primarily against CUDA 12.1 so far. Need their exact repro and perf markers.

Sophie (QA): I ran their micro-repro on our canary (A100, CUDA12.2, driver 530.41). Observed p50 token latency go from ~120ms -> ~140ms with a ~15% throughput drop. Short log snippet: ```2024-08-14T23:09:12Z runtime: batch=16 p50=140ms p95=280ms```

AJ (Eng Infra): Noted. Marketplace images are baked with driver 530.41 for cert parity. If we pin on our side, we need a special image branch and a hotfix deploy pipeline (canary -> soak -> promote). Propose branch: marketplace/driver-pin-530 and a 72h soak in eu-west-1.

Maria (Partnerships): Partner prefers pinning rather than moving forward; they need stability for their customers. They also asked whether we can provide a fallback lane to 525.x if regressions are observed. Also asked about ROCm parity for their SI customers.

Kai (Eng Runtime): For NVIDIA: short-term plan: 1) repro locally with partner input; 2) deploy runtime PR to canary; 3) run perf harness (same prompt set). If perf drop >10% we'll enable automatic fallback to a quantized model variant as a temporary mitigation. For ROCm: I don't think their SI runs ROCm in prod, but we should check.

Sophie (QA): I can run the full prompt suite against the canary once AJ spins it up. Command I used to collect logs: ```kubectl logs -n inference -l job=runtime-canary --since=2h | grep "batch="```

AJ (Eng Infra): I'll create the branch and a new image build job this afternoon. ETA for canary in eu-west-1: ~6 hours. Will wire up the soak pipeline and create a rollback playbook. Also adding a health-check that flips traffic back to 525.x image if p50 increases >20% for 10 minutes.

Maria (Partnerships): For ACME comms — I'll tell them we can offer a canary image with a 72h soak and a documented fallback path. Ask them for a sanitized repro and their perf dashboard.

Kai (Eng Runtime): Quick note on ROCm: there was an indexer bug reported in ROCm 5.6 that can surface as correctness or perf regressions. If partner wants ROCm parity, we'll need an additional integration sprint.

Sophie (QA): I'll queue the regression tests and tag @Maria when we have the initial metrics. If we hit the 15% perf delta again, recommend a hotfix release and a partner-facing incident note.

OpsBot: Canary image built: marketplace/driver-pin-530:20240814-06. Deployed to eu-west-1 canary pool (3 nodes).

AJ (Eng Infra): Canary is up. Running soak: https://internal.ci/soak/marketplace/driver-pin-530. Sophie ping me if you want more logs or to increase canary size.

Maria (Partnerships): Thanks all. Action items: *Maria* get ACME repro + perf dashboards; *AJ* create branch and canary (in progress); *Kai* validate runtime PR against canary; *Sophie* run full prompt suite and report numbers. Follow-up sync tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
